query: NVIDIA gaming segment GeForce revenue most recent quarter
normalized: gaming geforce nvidia quarter revenue segment

output.content:
NVIDIA no longer reports a standalone **GeForce/Gaming** revenue line beginning in FY2027; it has been incorporated into the broader **Edge Computing** category. [[1]] 

For the most recently reported quarter, **Q2 FY2027 ended July 26, 2026**, Edge Computing revenue was **$7.2 billion**, up **13% quarter over quarter** and **27% year over year**. [[2]]

sources.title: Nvidia Q2 FY27: $96.2B Beat, But GeForce Gaming Revenue Shrinks to $7.2B - GamesReviews.com
